description: This file contains role-related constants and utility functions for access control in the LMS frontend. It defines role constants, provides a function to check if a role is allowed, and a route guard helper to determine access permission based on path and user role.

methods.name: isRole(userRole, allowed)
methods.description: Checks if a user's role is within the allowed roles, returning true if allowed.

methods.name: canAccess(path, role)
methods.description: Determines if a role can access a given path, used as a route guard in the frontend.
